runtime.scope: QA005 Org / QA005 No Budget Project / QA005 Budgetless Dev

member.created_and_activated_through: real Owner invitation and enrollment UI

steps: Owner used the actual Access & Keys → Members & Roles form to add the synthetic identity with Team Admin only and QA005 No Budget Project scope.

The invite was activated through the real enrollment screen. Team Admin identity and project scope were verified in the real Console; invitation token/password remain mode-0600 outside the repository.
As Team Admin, opened the visible Register model action and submitted a new synthetic model. The actual request returned HTTP 201; UI success toast appeared.
Navigated to Logical Models, hard-reloaded, and verified UI row plus authenticated GET /admin/v1/models readback preserved id, slug, display name, DECLARED tier, dimensions and capabilities.

As the same Team Admin, used Add deployment with the existing active QA loopback Ollama connection, zero-rate self-hosted declaration and no provider dispatch. POST returned HTTP 201 and ACTIVE_HEALTHY.

Hard-reloaded and verified deployment remained Healthy in Console and authenticated GET /admin/v1/deployments returned the same deployment, ACTIVE_HEALTHY state, active connection, model and all-zero rate card.

classification.finding: Current exact RC7 behavior contradicts the historical QA-004 Team Admin registration denial: Team Admin-only scoped account created and persisted a logical model and active healthy deployment through the real Console.
classification.historical_conflict: Historical QA-004 HTTP 403 remains preserved and is not erased. Current result is exact frozen RC7 on isolated SQLite, so the scoped current-baseline slice passes.
limitations: Only one pure Team Admin identity, one project scope, one SQLite runtime and Chromium were tested.
No cross-project/organization scope, edit/delete, deployment failure, nonzero pricing, other model capabilities, or other roles/backends/browsers tested.
No inference was sent; provider connection is a local deterministic fixture; deployment is explicitly zero-rate.
The logical model retirement action was not present in the registry UI; PG-004 covers missing model retirement controls, so the test model/deployment remain isolated test data.
